description: If every member of a family T of finite histories has a one-term extension in T, then each prescribed history in T extends to an infinite sequence whose prefixes of every length at least the prescribed length belong to T.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.successive_selections.{u} {α : Type u} (T : Set (List α))
  (hT : ∀ s ∈ T, ∃ t ∈ T, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.OneTermExtension s t) (s₀ : List α) (hs₀ : s₀ ∈ T) :
  ∃ f, (List.ofFn fun i => f ↑i) = s₀ ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), (List.ofFn fun i => f ↑i) ∈ T
